_comment: Galaxies of the Local Group and Local Volume. Sources: (1) McConnachie A.W. 2012, AJ 144, 4, 'The observed properties of dwarf galaxies in and around the Local Group', VizieR J/AJ/144/4 (https://vizier.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/VizieR?-source=J/AJ/144/4); (2) Karachentsev I.D., Makarov D.I., Kaisina E.I. 2013, AJ 145, 101, 'Updated nearby galaxy catalog', VizieR J/AJ/145/101 (https://vizier.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/VizieR?-source=J/AJ/145/101). Both retrieved 2026-10-06 via the VizieR catalogue access tool, CDS, Strasbourg, France (terms: https://cds.unistra.fr/vizier-org/licences_vizier.html). Cuts: Karachentsev et al. list galaxies within 11 Mpc or with V_LG < 600 km/s; we keep only Dist <= 11 Mpc (the catalogue's distance limit) and drop the Milky Way itself. McConnachie (2012) covers galaxies within about 3 Mpc; all entries except 'The Galaxy' are kept. Entries were cross-matched by position (<= 6 arcmin): for matches the name, position and distance come from McConnachie (D in kpc / 1000) and the diameter from Karachentsev et al. (A26). Fields: raDeg/decDeg J2000 (sexagesimal converted to degrees), distMpc heliocentric, diamKpc = Karachentsev et al. A26 major linear (Holmberg) diameter (null = not catalogued), src = M12 / K13 / M12+K13; tType = Karachentsev et al. numerical morphological type (de Vaucouleurs RC3 scale), morph = McConnachie MType where matched, else Karachentsev et al. dwarf class (Mcl); absMagB = absolute B magnitude (BMag); logLumK = log10 Ks-band luminosity in solar units (KLum); distMethod = Karachentsev et al. f_Dist (TRGB, Cep, TF, h = Hubble law ...) or M12.
source: McConnachie (2012) AJ 144, 4; Karachentsev, Makarov & Kaisina (2013) AJ 145, 101; via VizieR (CDS, Strasbourg)
limitNote: Karachentsev et al. (2013): an all-sky catalog of nearby galaxies having individual distance estimates within 11 Mpc
